$description: Flamescope design tokens (dark theme). Applied as Tailwind @theme values in site/src/app/globals.css and mirrored in site/public/deck.html. SI-generated: proposed by Claude (frontend-design, design-system, and design-taste-frontend skills) at the team's request.

semantics.ember: the one accent: buttons, section labels, warnings, high-oxygen end of the evidence map
semantics.flame: data encoding only: low-oxygen end of the evidence map, SI answer tags
semantics.ok: rows checked against source by a second person

color.map-scale: color-mix(in oklch, flame, ember) by oxygen fraction between the lowest and highest O2 in eligible runs

font.sans: Geist (400, 500, 600) for all reading text and headlines
font.mono: Geist Mono (400, 500) for numbers, IDs, and table figures

motion.reduced-motion: still flame frame; typewriter, shimmer, and breathing dot stop
